name: MatchdaySquadSelectionBoard
tagline: Pick the XI, name the bench and confirm a rule-checked team sheet – in one Power Apps control.
description: Football matchday app for clubs and academies: player availability (injuries, illness, suspensions, international duty, fitness tests), formation pitch with drag-and-drop starting XI, bench and captaincy, continuous selection checks (goalkeeper rules, bench size, suspended or unregistered players, duplicate numbers, card risk, low readiness) and a confirmable team sheet with copy and export. Demo mode with fictional Harbour City FC data.
features: Bench capacity and substitute goalkeeper rules
Availability board with required notes, return dates and ban lengths
Confirm / re-open team sheet with guard
Copy as text, CSV export, TeamSheetJson output
